results.text: Free cancellation applies until 2 days before check-in. Cancel at any point before that deadline and nothing is charged; cancellations after the deadline are charged for the first night of the stay.

check_in_kyoto.query: What time can we check in and drop our bags in Kyoto?

results.heading: Check-out
results.text: Check-out is by 10:00 on the departure day, the standard rhythm for Japanese properties. Late check-out can be requested the evening before and is granted subject to availability. Luggage forwarding services at the station ship bags between cities if the departure flight leaves late.
results.title: Kyoto check-in and check-out guide

results.heading: Check-in
results.text: Check-in starts at 15:00 for the Kyoto hotels in this collection. Guests present passports at the front desk, as Japanese lodging law requires identification from every adult staying overnight. Luggage can be stored at reception until the room is ready.
results.title: Kyoto check-in and check-out guide

results.heading: Local notes
results.text: Kyoto runs on Japan Standard Time. Slippers replace shoes indoors in machiya and ryokan stays, and cash remains useful for small shops although cards are widely taken. Trash separation follows the neighbourhood rules posted in each room.
results.title: Kyoto check-in and check-out guide

results.heading: Cancellation terms
results.text: Free cancellation applies until 3 days before check-in. Cancel before that point and nothing is charged; cancellations after the deadline are charged for the first night of the stay.
results.title: Kyoto Station Tower cancellation and refund policy

pet_policy_kyoto.query: Are dogs and cats allowed to stay at the townhouse?

results.heading: Pets at Gion Machiya Stay
results.text: Pets are allowed at this property. The townhouse layout, with its own entrance and a contained courtyard, makes it an easy stay for a well-behaved small dog or cat.
results.title: Gion Machiya Stay pet policy

results.heading: Practical notes
results.text: Tell the house about the animal when booking so the ground-floor room can be assigned. A small cleaning surcharge may apply and is confirmed before arrival.
results.title: Gion Machiya Stay pet policy

results.heading: Comfort details
results.text: Yukata robes, tea sets and a shared tea corner are part of the stay. The house is pet-friendly, so a well-behaved animal can stay in the ground-floor room with its own bedding. The staff can arrange bicycle hire, and umbrellas stand by the entrance for rainy days.
results.title: Gion Machiya Stay amenities

results.heading: Rules and comfort
results.text: Animals stay off the tatami in wet weather, sleep on their own bedding brought from home, and stay supervised in the courtyard. Food and water bowls are available from the house.
results.title: Gion Machiya Stay pet policy

spa_vancouver.query: a waterfront hotel with a spa and an indoor pool

results.heading: Wellness
results.text: The indoor pool runs lanes through the morning and open swim later in the day. The spa offers massages, facials and a hot-and-cold circuit, booked at the spa desk. The gym shares the pool level and opens early.
results.title: Coal Harbour Grand amenities

results.heading: About the hotel
results.text: Coal Harbour Grand is a 5-star waterfront business hotel in Vancouver. It combines a full-service spa, an indoor pool, a fitness centre and covered parking under one roof, with the waterfront seawall at the doorstep.
results.title: Coal Harbour Grand overview

results.heading: Harbour King
results.text: The Harbour King sleeps up to 2 guests in a king bed. It is a full-width room with a harbour-view window, wi-fi, air conditioning, a marble bathroom and a compact work desk with a harbour-facing chair.
results.title: Coal Harbour Grand rooms

results.heading: View notes
results.text: Harbour-facing rooms watch the marina and float planes; city-facing rooms on the opposite side trade the view for a slightly lower position in the house. Both keep the same fittings.
